images.title: Fold and see if it matches
images.purpose: Show that two halves are mirror halves only when one covers the other exactly after the fold.
images.composition: Two shapes side by side with wide space between them, each with a dotted line down the middle.
images.exact_structure: Left: one isosceles triangle with a dotted vertical line from its top corner down the middle, left and right halves exactly equal, filled teal #0072B2, with one tick beside it. Right: two joined puzzle pieces, the left piece with a bump on its right edge and the right piece with a flat edge, a dotted vertical line at the join, filled amber #E69F00, with one cross beside it. Exactly 2 shapes, 2 dotted lines, 1 tick, 1 cross.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a tick placed on the puzzle pieces or a cross on the triangle
images.takeaway: Only an exact match gives mirror halves.
images.description: A triangle folded along its dotted middle line whose halves match exactly, next to joined puzzle pieces with a bump and a flat edge that do not match.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say which dotted line is a fold where one half covers the other exactly.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
